caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal decorative border positioned near the top center of an otherwise blank, light beige background. The border consists of a repeating pattern with symmetrical, stylized yellow and brown motifs that resemble upward-facing fans or shells, each with three elongated elements that taper downward and are adorned with small, round yellow accents. These motifs are spaced evenly along a teal-green strip that forms the main body of the border. Behind and between the motifs, small, less prominent mint-green shapes with a narrow base and a bulbous end can be seen. Above the teal-green area, there are two narrow parallel stripes in golden yellow and brown, with the upper edge of the border featuring a zigzag yellow line on top of the teal. The outermost top and bottom edges of the border are outlined with thin yellow lines. The rest of the image is unadorned and serves as negative space.
title: Wallpaper Border
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
